phase_detail: CBA still in force; owners expected to lock out players when it expires
headline: Owners tabled a revised hard cap starting in 2028, the union rejected it, and a lockout after Dec. 1 is still widely expected.
latest: MLB delivered a revised proposal on Nov. 3 that delays the hard cap to 2028 and sets it at $258.2M with a $180.2M floor. The union said it would still blow up the current system and no bargaining sessions have been reported.
